closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, fibre, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low calcium, and best used ground/processed appropriately. Polyunsaturated fat is 28.7 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling, but it is the lowest mark here but still a strong one. For seeds, the fat profile is one of the biggest reasons they earn their place.
